statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-56848 is a Node.js HTTP/2 flaw: submitting an RST_STREAM with the REFUSED_STREAM code while nghttp2 is processing received data could call nghttp2_session_mem_send() re-entrantly from inside nghttp2_session_mem_recv(), a heap use-after-free. Node.js fixed it for 22.x in 22.23.2, the 2026-07-29 security release (https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases; release notes https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.23.2), and its CVE record lists 22.x as affected through 22.23.1. The 22.x fix is commit daa6d25e3d, 'http2: defer rst stream while in scope' (https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/daa6d25e3d), which carries this CVE id: Http2Stream::SubmitRstStream() in src/node_http2.cc in that case now submits the RST_STREAM to nghttp2 without first forcing pending data out, the step that re-entered nghttp2; Node.js 22.23.1 does not have that branch. We read usr/bin/node, the only file each package installs, in every nodejs-22 package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 2026-11-28, on x86_64 and aarch64: 13 builds from 22.22.0-r0 to the current 22.23.5-r0, each checked against its repository index checksum. 22.22.0-r0 through 22.23.1-r0 (22.22.0-r0, 22.22.1-r0, 22.22.2-r0, 22.22.2-r1, 22.22.3-r0, 22.23.0-r0 and 22.23.1-r0) report Node.js v22.22.0 through v22.23.1; 22.23.2-r0 is the first that reports v22.23.2, and 22.23.3-r0 through 22.23.5-r0 report v22.23.3 through v22.23.5. The fix changes only compiled C++ code and adds no text we can search for in the binary, so the boundary rests on the Node.js release each build reports. Two other fixes from the same release do leave a trace in the binary: NodeTraceWriter::GetFilePath (CVE-2026-56847) is present in 22.23.2-r0 and every later build, and getPfxAgentKey() in lib/https.js (CVE-2026-56850) is present in 22.23.2-r0 through 22.23.4-r2 and replaced in 22.23.5-r0 by getKeyMaterialAgentKey(); neither is in any earlier build, consistent with that release.
